rows.title: Whey protein phospholipid concentrate at the interface of function and health: Heat-induced protein interactions, bioactivity, and choline delivery.
rows.evidence_boundary: This work centers on composition, processing, phospholipid/choline delivery, and proposed bioactivity of WPPC; manufacturing and nutrient-delivery data are not direct clinical efficacy evidence.

rows.title: Neuropharmacology of Cannabinoids: A Comprehensive Review of Preclinical and Clinical Evidence for Hemp-Derived Extracts and Active Compounds.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review spans THC, CBD, extracts, and other phytocannabinoids across preclinical and clinical evidence; effects, risks, and mechanisms are compound-, dose-, and route-specific.

rows.title: Targeting cellular senescence with Traditional Chinese Medicine: advances in neurodegenerative disorder treatment.
rows.evidence_boundary: The senescence-focused TCM literature is largely mechanistic and preclinical, with heterogeneous multi-component preparations; clinical neurodegenerative efficacy remains unproven.

rows.title: Effects of inhaled lavender essential oil on sleep quality, pain, and anxiety in ICU patients after curative hepatocellular carcinoma resection: a quasi-experimental study.
rows.evidence_boundary: This nonrandomized sequential-group ICU study is vulnerable to confounding and is specific to postoperative liver-cancer patients and inhaled lavender aromatherapy.

rows.title: A single-center open-label, randomized, parallel-group controlled clinical trial on the long-term effect of the treatment with EGb 761 in blood markers of inflammation and neurodegeneration in patients with mild cognitive impairment: ACE-2020-EGb 761.
rows.evidence_boundary: The study is single-center and open-label with no-treatment control and uses standardized EGb 761 in MCI; biomarker and cognition findings should not be generalized to all Ginkgo products.
